title: Reconstruct a studio object + stage + lighting from four multi-view reference photos

prompts.text: The four attached photos show the same small object staged in a studio, captured from four viewpoints: a front-3/4 view, a right-side view, a back-3/4 view, and an elevated view. Reproduce the ENTIRE setup in the current scene: the object itself (use SDF geometry -- it is a single smooth organic form), its material, the stage (ground plane + backdrop), the lighting (how many lights, their direction, and their colour temperature), and the environment tint. The scene camera already matches the first (front-3/4) photo's viewpoint exactly -- do not move it. The scene already carries a painter named `pnt_env` wired into the renderer's environment map (currently black) -- set its colour to match the environment tint you observe; you cannot and need not touch the rasterizer itself. First read the modeling-from-image-captures skill and follow its multi-view verification loop. Iterate (render, inspect, adjust) until your renders match all four photos.
